snippet.title: DETECTIVE Rainy Night  - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
#steam #steamdeck 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3389720?utm_source=youtube

#playstation5 
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10017020

#nintendoswitch2 
https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/detective-rainy-night-switch/

#xboxseries #xboxplayanywhere #microsoftstore 
https://www.xbox.com/es-es/games/store/detective-rainy-night/9mwvmdzbgwzh

Detective Rainy Night puts you in the shoes of Iker Carmona, a seasoned police officer investigating a series of mysterious disappearances in a remote area. After a long day of driving, Iker seeks refuge at the "Holiday" motel for a much-needed rest, unaware that his stay will soon unravel into a chilling nightmare.

Set over five days across 12 narrative-driven levels, Detective Rainy Night takes you on a gripping journey of suspense and terror. As you speak with the motel guests—each with their own secrets and stories—you'll need to carefully piece together the mystery surrounding the strange disappearances, eerie deaths, and cryptic symbols that seem to plague the place. With your police instincts and keen observation, you must question the guests, uncover hidden truths, and connect the dots to solve the case.

Features

- Narrative-Driven Adventure: Experience a deeply immersive story with compelling characters and a dark atmosphere.
- Interrogation and Deduction: Speak to seven distinct guests, interrogating them and analyzing their stories.
- Psychological Horror: The motel becomes a character of its own, with unsettling occurrences.
- Unfolding Events: Every day brings new twists and challenges.
- Complex Mystery: With violent crimes and mature themes, the case you’re investigating is not an easy one.

©2025 JanduSoft & K148 Game Studios
